narrative.northStar: The Tactical Air Traffic Control Tower
narrative.overview: RoutePilot's visual design system embodies the discipline, restraint, and precision of a mission-critical logistics command center. Designed specifically for dispatch controllers and fleet managers executing high-density route planning, the interface treats every pixel as operational real estate. Unnecessary decorative gradients, consumer glassmorphism, and frivolous animations are strictly rejected in favor of high-legibility typographic hierarchy, crisp tabular data, and purposeful color contrast.
keyCharacteristics: High-Density Operational Scannability: Tight vertical rhythm, compact data rows, and zero empty padding bloat.
Tonal Layering Over Shadows: Structural hierarchy established through dark slate surfaces and fine hairline borders rather than muddy elevation shadows.
Monospace Entity Rigor: Distinct monospace typography for all entity keys, machine codes, and geographical coordinates.
Strict Visual Cohesion: Seamless aesthetic continuity across Overview, Route Planning, Fleet, and Deliveries modules.

rules.name: The Restrained Cyan Rule
rules.body: Electric cyan must never exceed 5% of any viewport. Its power comes from scarcity—guiding the operator's eye directly to actionable buttons, active routes, and execution states.

rules.name: The Monospace Identifier Rule
rules.body: All operational entities (delivery IDs, run IDs, vehicle registrations, site IDs, and GPS coordinates) must be rendered in monospace typography. Proportional fonts are forbidden for system entity keys.

rules.name: The Tonal Boundary Rule
rules.body: Depth is created by contrasting adjacent surfaces (#0b1220 vs #101827) paired with a 1px border. Drop shadows are restricted to subtle glow highlights under focused buttons or active pills.

dos: Do use monospace typography for every identifier (runId, deliveryId, vehicleId, siteId).
Do label route distance and duration as estimates derived from straight-line Haversine math.
Do maintain a strict 1px border hierarchy (border-white/[0.07]) to delineate dark surfaces.
Do preserve high data density in tables and lists so dispatchers can review routes without excessive vertical scrolling.
Do provide clear, contextual empty and loading states across all four operational modules.
donts: Don't use generic AI-generated aesthetic tropes (blurry glassmorphism, heavy radial gradients, floating 3D spheres).
Don't use decorative animations that slow down user interaction or page responsiveness.
Don't use Electric Cyan as a background fill for large cards or structural sidebars.
Don't truncate operational IDs without providing full visual tooltips or copy access.
Don't invent fake REST endpoints or mock data when the backend architecture boundary is clear.
